title: Glyph, Sound and Blood
narration_slice: forgotten eastern teachers, stumbled upon through desperate survival, or refined across centuries of lethal trial and error among the calderas, the Valyrians unlocked something unprecedented in human affairs - not mere animal taming, like breaking a courser, but dominion forged through fire, glyph, sound, and blood.
filing_note: 0501, 0502, 0504, 0505 and 0506 were generated in the same turn as Batch 050's close and were briefly uploaded into the 050 folder by mistake; they were moved to this folder with update_file (add/remove parents) and the 050 folder was re-listed to confirm it holds exactly ten frames.
the_phrase_rule: This batch is where the narration names the thing the visuals have been building: **dominion forged through fire, glyph, sound, and blood** - explicitly NOT animal taming, explicitly not 'breaking a courser'. The images must therefore never show anyone riding, haltering, touching or training a dragon. What they show instead is procedure: heat, broken stone, bandaged arms, exhaustion, the arithmetic of attrition, and one crack in a rock with heat inside it.

scenes.visual_beat: Dynamic medium lateral tracking angle — Lethal cavern trials of fire, glyph, sound, and blood
scenes.qc_note: 35mm tracking laterally at knee height: **a young candidate running hard across scored basalt**, body leaning into the run, ash-stiffened hair flat with sweat, bare feet striking stone, the trailing edge of a short tunic flying. The motion is a hard diagonal. Behind her two others are already down on the stone, seen from above and behind as dark shapes - one on hands and knees, one collapsed forward, both faceless. Fine ash kicks up at her feet. Lit hard from the trench at frame left with a long shadow running right. **Momentum, not spectacle.**

scenes.visual_beat: Compressed telephoto dramatic subject framing — Lethal cavern trials of fire, glyph, sound, and blood
scenes.qc_note: 65mm compressed long-lens: **a young candidate kneels with their back to us**, head down, shoulders heaving, one hand braced flat on the stone and the other hanging loose. Sweat and ash have run together down the spine and dried in pale streaks on dark skin; the tunic is scorched grey at the hem. The telephoto flattens a background of hard angular basalt strata with ash on every ledge, and further back the soft orange of the trench. The figure sits low with **a great deal of empty black stone above its head**. Rim-lit from behind and below. **Exhaustion, and the smallness of one person in that room.**

Wide environmental storytelling tableau — Lethal cavern trials of fire, glyph, sound, and blood
scenes.qc_note: 35mm wide, standing height, in near-darkness: **eleven exhausted candidates sit against a low rock shelf**, knees drawn up or legs out, heads down or turned away, all faceless, feet and hands black with soot. Out on the middle of the floor, apart from them, **four dark shapes lie flat and still under strips of coarse cloth**, and **nobody is kneeling over them and nobody is looking at them.** The trench burns low at frame right, reaching only the edge of the group. A huge area of the upper frame is unlit black. **The arithmetic of a trial, filmed without comment.**

scenes.visual_beat: High-elevation geographic / scale reveal — Lethal cavern trials of fire, glyph, sound, and blood
scenes.qc_note: 24mm from the caldera rim at night: **the whole basin below**, a vast shallow bowl of ash and old lava with **one long orange fire trench** and six or seven distant points of fire scattered across it where other trials are under way. Rim walls of dry black basalt fall away in jagged steps. Thin smoke lies in the basin catching the firelight. Beyond the far rim a black horizon against a slightly paler overcast sky - **no moon, no stars.** A few small faceless figures stand on the rim in the near foreground, backs to us. **A process running in many places at once, all of them small.**

scenes.visual_beat: Towering vertical scale composition — Lethal cavern trials of fire, glyph, sound, and blood
scenes.qc_note: 24mm tilted steeply up a **great natural fissure in dry black basalt**: jagged, irregular, hard-edged, its sides stepped and fractured with sharp spalled edges and ash crusted in the cracks. **Inside the rock the stone is heated - dull red-orange, brightest low down and fading to black as the crack climbs.** It is rock, not fire: no flames, no glow spilling out, only heat in the stone and a faint shimmer of hot air. At the base, small enough to be swallowed, **a single young candidate stands with their head tilted back**, a dark silhouette against the red, no face. **Something unprecedented, and it is only heat in a crack in the ground.**
